SSL Checker

Check any domain's SSL certificate in one click: validity status, issuer, valid-from and expiry dates, and days remaining.

Checked live via our own API endpoint (/api/ssl). Paste just the domain — no https:// needed.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the domain you want to check, e.g. example.com.
  2. Click Check SSL to read the domain's live certificate.
  3. Review the validity badge, issuer, dates and days remaining.
  4. Renew or replace the certificate before it expires to avoid browser warnings.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does this check?

It reads the domain's live SSL/TLS certificate: who issued it, when it is valid, and how many days remain.

What if the certificate is invalid?

Renew it with your hosting provider or certificate authority (for example Let's Encrypt) to avoid browser security warnings.

How often should I check?

Certificates typically expire every 90 days to a year, so check monthly or enable auto-renewal.
